owner: Existing UI builder, single frontend. Integrator owns routes and shared contracts.
direction: A, English product copy, AdaptOps. Proposed home composition A awaits user preference. No new app or design identity.
connectionGate: No route is inferred and no industrial API is called before the integrator publishes its exact root HTTP contract.

mapping.display: Activity, geography, origin, received date and distinct source/business revisions. No 10k counter from a partial array length. Backend must identify totals and their scope if displayed.

states: read error with last received report retained
mapping.display: Saved report before the follow-up question. Do not equate a saved report with an automatic trigger unless its intent/receipt attests that trigger.

Declared synthetic industrial-fire scenario and confirmed synthetic interruptions remain distinct from public-source observations. Exact source references need server hydration, including title, URL, dates, content hash and provenance.
Show the received native entity links and provenance. Never infer a supplier/concurrent/customer relation from a public title or text match.
Render the server impact enum and known missing facts. Qualified synthetic CRM demand is not a live customer commitment. Unknown or unreceived opportunity remains explicit.

mapping.block: Common purchasing, operations and commercial plan
mapping.display: Open the exact recommended plan when present, otherwise explain the missing result. Steps use their server kind and dependencies. Display monetary cents as EUR, without recomputing feasibility, capacity or contribution in the UI. Null economics stay unknown.

Separate plan review and approval receipt. Never send a C1 proposal decision for an industrial plan. Exact command route/body, role/permission receipt and stale/conflict codes are integrator dependencies.

Simulation label and explicit applied/failed/uncertain state. An approval never marks an action executed. Show actual native result records and received before/after revisions. No automatic retry after an uncertain command.
Preserve prior report/plan/decision/result versions and mark stale. Request reevaluation through the published command. Operator-only release or correction does not become a user form by default.

httpNeededFromIntegrator: Exact authenticated root read route and envelope for company/context/report/event/plan/approval/execution, including empty and partial states.
Complete-versus-partial totals, data freshness and server-computed action eligibility.
Source-reference hydration or an exact embedded evidence DTO.
Routes and validated bodies for reevaluate, approve/reject and execute/reconcile, with stable operation-key semantics.
Native IDs, current versions and expected basis checks for every mutation receipt.
Correction/revision authority and history scope, including what remains operator-only.
validationPlanned: Aside first, real candidate readback after route receipt
Nominal, no report, read failure, needs input, stale, conflicting version and uncertain command
Wrong company/actor/plan/version/hash and mismatched source references
Approved versus executed distinction and exact durable result IDs
CSS small-screen measurements and keyboard flow
Two independent exact-code reviews and a separate industrial UI manifest
